mechanism: The change moves the dedup and close key of a feed item from the feed URL to the feed host under a new key_version, and rows stored under the earlier version are ignored on lookup, so a re-import adds every known item again and marking one read closes only the new copy.
why_unseen: The finding changed the zero-padding of a review-ledger display id inside a replayed ledger; this is a host-based feed-item key with an explicit stored key_version, and the exempt control changes only the label style of a reading list (both files modify earlier versions held in base/), while dedup and closing use an unchanged stored uid.
